summary: KE Holdings filed a Form 6-K containing Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns covering September 21–25, 2026, disclosing changes in issued shares and a series of repurchases. The exhibits detail buybacks of WVR ordinary shares (HKEX: 02423) from May through August 2026 at prices ranging roughly HKD 36.08 to HKD 45.01, with US-market purchases around USD 5.72. Shares are held as treasury pending cancellation. The filing is administrative, not a tender offer or going-private event. Watch for cumulative cancellation mechanics and any further program disclosures.
